name: gizza-ai/sm2-keypair-generate
summary: Generate an SM2 key pair (PEM + hex)

tool.description: Generate a fresh SM2 key pair (Chinese national standard GM/T 0003, OSCCA curve sm2p256v1) and return the private key (PKCS#8 PEM), the public key (SPKI PEM), the raw 32-byte private scalar in hex, and the public point in SEC1 hex (both uncompressed and compressed). Keys are generated locally with a cryptographic RNG (getrandom). SM2 is the OSCCA-mandated 256-bit elliptic-curve scheme used for signatures and key exchange in Chinese government and commercial systems.
